Email.footer: Spirit O Santa · Kids earn gifts with good deeds. You got this email because someone used this address on Spirit O Santa.
Email.ignore: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Nothing will change.
Email.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Spirit O Santa
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for signing up your store on Spirit O Santa. Please confirm this is your email address.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link works once and expires in 24 hours.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Spirit O Santa account
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to sign up with this email address, but it already has an account. You can sign in, or reset your password if you've forgotten it.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Spirit O Santa password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We got a request to reset the password for this email address.
resetPassword.expiry: This link works once and expires in 1 hour.

inviteOwner.subject: You're invited to list your store on Spirit O Santa
inviteOwner.heading: Your store is invited
inviteOwner.body: Spirit O Santa has invited {storeName} to list gift items for local kids. Set your password and accept the store agreement to get started.
inviteOwner.expiry: This link works once and expires in 7 days.

storeApproved.subject: {storeName} is approved on Spirit O Santa
storeApproved.heading: Your store is approved
storeApproved.body: Good news: {storeName} is approved. Families can now see your store and items. Sign in to manage your item list.

storeRejected.subject: About your Spirit O Santa application
storeRejected.heading: Application not approved
storeRejected.body: We weren't able to approve {storeName} at this time. Reason: {reason}. If you have questions, contact the Spirit O Santa team.

inviteRep.subject: You're invited to help run a store on Spirit O Santa
inviteRep.heading: Join your store's team
inviteRep.body: You've been invited to help manage {storeName}'s gift items on Spirit O Santa. Choose your name and password to get started.
inviteRep.expiry: This link works once and expires in 7 days.
